title: Sordland/Turn04/EnT_TaxReform
description: Tax reform increase or decrease meeting with the economics team.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were at the top floor of the bus..."
entries.dialogueText: We were at the top floor of the business council building which had a great view of the beautiful Lachaven. I looked outside from the tall glass windows.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tracing back the paths of the ships..."
entries.dialogueText: Tracing back the paths of the ships, I looked at the harbour. Lachaven was home to one of the largest harbours in the entire continent. Many dockyard workers were loading or unloading the containers. Work never stopped here.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Markian Sea stretched as far as..."
entries.dialogueText: The Markian Sea stretched as far as the eye could see and it was dotted with many ships towards the horizon. They were mostly cargo ships, carrying precious goods in and out of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door opened. Symon, Mikail and..."
entries.dialogueText: The door opened. Symon, Mikail and Edith entered the meeting room.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon put down his bag on the table..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon put down his bag on the table and started collecting his documents while the others slowly took their seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon waited patiently. Once everyo..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon waited patiently. Once everyone was ready, he adjusted his glasses.

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Good afternoon, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good afternoon, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. President. So nice to see you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. So nice to see you again.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“First of all, I would like to than..."
entries.dialogueText: “First of all, I would like to thank everyone here for their work on our tax system reform.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good afternoon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good afternoon.”
entries.menuText: “Good afternoon.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's great to see you all again.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's great to see you all again.”
entries.menuText: “It's great to see you all again.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Take a seat and let's begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Take a seat and let's begin.”
entries.menuText: “Take a seat and let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We all know how complicated our cu..."
entries.dialogueText: “We all know how complicated our current system is and this work wouldn't be possible without you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Before we move ahead and start for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Before we move ahead and start formulating a plan, we need you to determine our direction, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We have a few possibilities as a r..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have a few possibilities as a result of the work we have done so far.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We can increase, maintain or decre..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can increase, maintain or decrease the taxes for large corporations. I believe some of us in the room have a few strong opinions about this.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“In parallel, we can increase, main..."
entries.dialogueText: “In parallel, we can increase, maintain or decrease the taxes for small and medium businesses.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The ultimate goal here is to end t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The ultimate goal here is to end the recession.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Let's start with the large corpora..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's start with the large corporations. And we'll move on to small businesses.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is the outcome if we increase..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is the outcome if we increase the taxes for large corporations?”
entries.menuText: “What is the outcome if we increase the taxes for large corporations?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What if we decrease the taxes for..."
entries.dialogueText: “What if we decrease the taxes for large corporations?”
entries.menuText: “What if we decrease the taxes for large corporations?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does everyone think we should..."
entries.dialogueText: “What does everyone think we should do?”
entries.menuText: “What does everyone think we should do?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am ready to make a decision.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am ready to make a decision.”
entries.menuText: “I am ready to make a decision.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Simply put, if we increase the tax..."
entries.dialogueText: “Simply put, if we increase the taxes, we will have more government budget to spend which may come in handy. On the other hand, it's not directly helping us revitalise the economy.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Our government is already in debt...."
entries.dialogueText: “Our government is already in debt. This might be a way to get out of that debt.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Our government budget will be hit...."
entries.dialogueText: “Our government budget will be hit. But in return, due to the sheer size of the economic contribution coming from these companies, it should be helpful in curbing the recession.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I do think this is definitely a go..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do think this is definitely a good option if we want to end the recession.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is there any downside to keeping t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is there any downside to keeping the things as they are?”
entries.menuText: “Is there any downside to keeping the things as they are?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I am of the opinion that if we don..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am of the opinion that if we don't make any changes, nothing will change. To stop the recession, we need to do something.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“My personal opinion is that we sho..."
entries.dialogueText: “My personal opinion is that we should decrease the taxes for large corporations. Although in short term it would cost us, in the long run it would be the most helpful option in ending the recession.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We already have a budget surplus...."
entries.dialogueText: “We already have a budget surplus. I don't see much value in increasing our capital without investing it in possibilities that might help end the recession.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“However, there is one problem. The..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, there is one problem. The status of our budget. This might not be the greatest idea although it has its benefits. You will have to decide if it's worth the risk.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Especially with the current state..."
entries.dialogueText: “Especially with the current state of our budget.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I do believe there is one way to g..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do believe there is one way to get out of recession. It is through the trade and the economic contribution of large corporations. Increasing their taxes will turn them on you.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“I will go a step further. Increasi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will go a step further. Increasing their taxes will have disastrous results and it will make you an enemy of them. Trust me, Mr. President. Nobody wants to make an enemy of them.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I think this is a viable idea. Ups..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think this is a viable idea. Upsetting the existing balance might be less than ideal.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Me too. You would have the Group o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Me too. You would have the Group on your good side on top of solving the recession crisis, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I think so too.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I think so too.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Agreed. ”"
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. ”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Our international trade is driven..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our international trade is driven mostly by the products of these corporations. They are the backbone of our economy.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Exactly. If we let them perform be..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly. If we let them perform better by decreasing their taxes, this should in turn lead to Sordland receiving more investment. This means more capital which means a quicker way out of the recession.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Very well, Mr. President. We want..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well, Mr. President. We want to ensure the economy is on a balanced track as further destabilization might have drastic consequences.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They better try to stay on *my* go..."
entries.dialogueText: “They better try to stay on *my* good side.”
entries.menuText: “They better try to stay on *my* good side.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have to agree. Being their ally..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have to agree. Being their ally would come in handy.”
entries.menuText: “I have to agree. Being their ally would come in handy.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It goes both ways, Mr. Aven.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It goes both ways, Mr. Aven.”
entries.menuText: “It goes both ways, Mr. Aven.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maybe you are right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe you are right.”
entries.menuText: “Maybe you are right.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“You are making a mistake.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are making a mistake.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“This will not change anything.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This will not change anything.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“An excellent decision.”"
entries.dialogueText: “An excellent decision.”

entries.dialogueText: “This is going to have outrageous effects down the road.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc

entries.dialogueText: “I agree. Thanks to this, the recession will be solved in no time.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl

entries.dialogueText: “Enough. The President has made his choice.”

entries.dialogueText: “Well then. I have taken a note of our action and I will put it to implementation as soon as possible.”
